device.description: Default device node to use when none is specified on the command line.

methods.description: List of eject methods to try (cdrom, scsi, floppy, tape). Empty means try all four in order.

auto_eject.description: Enable auto-eject when device is closed (on|off).

manual_eject.description: Disable hardware eject button when true (on|off).

no_partitions_unmount.description: Do not unmount other partitions on same device.

no_unmount.description: Do not attempt to unmount before ejecting.

use_proc_mounts.description: Use /proc/mounts instead of /etc/mtab for mounted device detection.

change_slot.description: Default slot number (0-indexed) for CD changers. -1 means no changer operation.

cd_speed.description: Default CD-ROM speed in X units (e.g., 8 = 8x). 0 = max speed. -1 means no change.
